name: search_site
title: Search excessionlabs.ai
description: Search the public pages and research notes on excessionlabs.ai. Returns titles, URLs and one-line summaries.

query.description: Words to search for, for example 'security assessment' or 'authorization testing'

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (1 to 20, default 8)

name: get_page
title: Get a page as Markdown
description: Read one public page of excessionlabs.ai as Markdown. Use a path from search_site or llms.txt.

path.description: Page path or full URL on excessionlabs.ai, for example '/', '/about/' or '/security-assessment/'

name: how_to_contact
title: How to contact Excession Labs
description: Return the ways a person can contact Excession Labs: the request form, email, and the request_security_test tool for agents.

name: request_security_test
title: Request a security test from Excession Labs
description: Send a request for a security test (web application, API, multi-tenant SaaS isolation or AI application) to Excession Labs on behalf of a person who asked for it. Needs an agent key (POST https://excessionlabs.ai/agent/auth, then Authorization: Bearer <key>). Excession Labs replies to the person by email to agree scope; testing starts only after a written scope and written authorization from the system owner. Never include passwords, API keys or customer data. Limits: 5 requests a day per key, 3 a day per email address.

email.description: The person's work email; Excession Labs replies here

company.description: The person's company or organization name

test_type.description: Kind of test: web_app, api, saas_multi_tenant, ai_application (LLM app or agent) or other

targets.description: Systems to test: URLs, API base URLs or short descriptions. No credentials.

reason.description: Why the person needs the test

timeline.description: When the person needs the result, in their words

notes.description: Other context from the person, up to 2,000 characters. No credentials or customer data.

person_consent.description: Must be true: the person asked for this request and agreed to be contacted by email

authorized.description: Must be true: the person owns these systems or may arrange a test of them

name: cve_search
title: Search CVEs and software versions
description: Search the hosted Excession Labs CVE database. Choose recent modification, new publication, or known-exploitation priority. Software/version filters match source assertions; they do not evaluate whether an installation is affected.

query.description: Substring to find in the indexed CVE text, at least three characters

version.description: Literal source version value; version ranges are returned as evidence, not evaluated

kev.description: True selects CISA KEV members; false selects records known not to be listed

sort.description: priority orders known exploitation first; recent orders source modifications; published orders new publication dates

published_since.description: Inclusive UTC publication date or ISO timestamp, for example 2026-11-01

include_unaffected.description: Include software assertions explicitly marked unaffected or fixed

limit.description: Maximum results in this page, from 1 to 50

offset.description: Result offset, up to 10000; use specific filters for broad queries

name: cve_get
title: Get a CVE with source evidence
description: Read a CVE's descriptions, severity, affected software/version evidence, source references, KEV and EPSS. Large affected-software lists are paginated; inspect the returned cursor and completeness fields.

affected_after.description: Cursor returned by the preceding page; zero starts at the beginning

affected_limit.description: Maximum results in this page, from 1 to 50

annotations.title: Get a CVE with source evidence

name: cve_history
title: Read hosted CVE revision history
description: Read normalized source revisions retained after hosted monitoring starts. Version claims can refer to shared affected_groups by group_id. Initial hosted observations establish a baseline; the initial snapshot is not a complete historical archive. Inspect returned coverage and pagination.

source.description: Optional source identifier, such as cve_list_v5 or nvd

after.description: Cursor returned by the preceding page; zero starts at the beginning

limit.description: Maximum results in this page, from 1 to 50

name: cve_status
title: Check CVE collection health
description: Read corpus counts, source coverage, collection errors, freshness and saved update checkpoints. A successful bounded query does not imply complete upstream coverage.

name: cve_sources
title: List vulnerability data sources
description: Read the hosted source catalog, attribution, update methods and coverage limits.

name: cve_changes
title: Read new and changed CVE records
description: Read hosted changes after a saved sequence cursor. Process the page before resuming with next_after. This is a read-only feed; it does not create a notification subscription.

after.description: Cursor returned by the preceding page; zero starts at the beginning

limit.description: Maximum results in this page, from 1 to 50

annotations.title: Read new and changed CVE records
